scope: dev only; 93 speech and 3 acoustic; no heldout inference or per-case rule use
source: benchmarks/recognition/frozen: original source, no parent silence/loop changes, equal across conditions
decode: original Fast off/source relevant/source distractor; instrumentation only
families: whole sentence baseline min or mean confidence conditional prompt decode
whole sentence protect all changed baseline words above confidence threshold
per-edit merge only prompt vocabulary replacements whose baseline confidence is low; preserve casing when same casefold token
optional candidate confidence floor / candidate-minus-baseline margin
requirements: zero dev lexical control false substitutions, no increase case flags, retain >=90% source relevant incremental name gain (>=29/42) and >=90% pooled incremental gain (>=44/84), pooled word errors <=792; inspect sensitivity and mixed/long/quiet buckets; candidate must be frozen before heldout
scoring: references/target/decoys used by scorer only; never gate inputs
